accountHolder.addressStructured.address: Address broken into semantically meaningful components. Complete street-level address as it appears in the document, combining all available street address components into a single field. This may include house or building number, street name, street type, apartment/suite/unit/floor, building or complex name, district, neighborhood, or sub-locality. Separate each address component using commas to preserve structure and enable downstream parsing. Preserve the original formatting and ordering from the source document whenever possible.
accountHolder.addressStructured.city: Address broken into semantically meaningful components. City or town name only, following standard U.S. addressing conventions where the city appears separately from the street address, state, and ZIP code. Extract only the locality value explicitly representing the city/town.
accountHolder.addressStructured.country: Address broken into semantically meaningful components. Country name or ISO alpha-3 code (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR'), only if explicitly printed.
accountHolder.addressStructured.postal_c: Address broken into semantically meaningful components. Postal or ZIP code.
accountHolder.addressStructured.state: Address broken into semantically meaningful components. State, province, or region code/name.
accountHolder.name: Full name of the account holder or entity as printed on the statement (e.g., 'John M. Smith', 'Acme Corp Ltd'). Extract verbatim.
currency: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this statement (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR').
isOverflowPage: True if this page is a mid-table continuation from the previous page — i.e., the transaction table carries over with no new statement header or account summary at the top. False if this page starts a fresh statement or a new transaction table header.
statementInfo.accountNumber: Account number as printed on the statement. May be fully or partially masked (e.g., '****1234', 'XXXX-XXXX-5678'). Extract verbatim — do not unmask or infer missing digits.
statementInfo.accountType: Type of account as labeled on the statement (e.g., 'Checking', 'Savings', 'Current', 'Money Market').
statementInfo.bankName: Name of the financial institution issuing the statement, exactly as printed (e.g., 'Chase Bank', 'HSBC', 'Bank of America').
statementInfo.closingBalance.originalVal: Account balance at the end of the statement period as printed. Also labeled 'Ending Balance', 'Closing Balance', or 'Balance Carried Forward'. The raw value exactly as it appears printed on the document (e.g. '1,234.56', '10%', '2 pcs'). Preserve bracket notation as-is (e.g. '(102.68)').
statementInfo.openingBalance.originalVal: Account balance at the start of the statement period as printed. Also labeled 'Beginning Balance', 'Opening Balance', or 'Balance Brought Forward'. The raw value exactly as it appears printed on the document (e.g. '1,234.56', '10%', '2 pcs'). Preserve bracket notation as-is (e.g. '(102.68)').
statementInfo.routingNumber: ABA routing/transit number as printed on the statement (9-digit US bank identifier). Extract verbatim — do not infer or correct digits. May appear labeled as 'Routing Number', 'ABA Number', or 'Transit Number'.
statementInfo.statementPeriodEnd: End date of the statement period exactly as printed.
statementInfo.statementPeriodEndISO: End date of the statement period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Derive from the printed value only.
statementInfo.statementPeriodStart: Start date of the statement period exactly as printed (e.g., 'Jan 1, 2024', '01/01/2024').
statementInfo.statementPeriodStartISO: Start date of the statement period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Derive from the printed value only.
transactions[*].amountIn.originalValue: Money flowing INTO the account for this transaction — regardless of transaction type. Maps to the credit, deposit, or 'CR' column on the statement. Populate this field for any transaction that adds funds to the account: incoming transfers, direct deposits, refunds, interest credits, cash deposits, etc. Extract the raw value exactly as printed (e.g., '1,250.00', '500'). Leave null only if this row has no value in the inflow column. The raw value exactly as it appears printed on the document (e.g. '1,234.56', '10%', '2 pcs'). Preserve bracket notation as-is (e.g. '(102.68)').
transactions[*].amountOut.originalValue: Money flowing OUT OF the account for this transaction — regardless of transaction type. Maps to the debit, withdrawal, or 'DR' column on the statement. Populate this field for any transaction that removes funds from the account: outgoing transfers, payments, purchases, fees, ATM withdrawals, cheques cleared, etc. Extract the raw value exactly as printed. Some statements show outflows in brackets (e.g., '(200.00)') — preserve bracket notation as-is. Leave null only if this row has no value in the outflow column. The raw value exactly as it appears printed on the document (e.g. '1,234.56', '10%', '2 pcs'). Preserve bracket notation as-is (e.g. '(102.68)').
transactions[*].balance.originalValue: The running account balance after this transaction has been applied, as printed in the balance or 'running total' column of the statement. Extract the value exactly as printed. Leave null if the statement does not show a per-row balance. The raw value exactly as it appears printed on the document (e.g. '1,234.56', '10%', '2 pcs'). Preserve bracket notation as-is (e.g. '(102.68)').
transactions[*].date: The date of the transaction exactly as it appears printed on the statement. Preserve the original format (e.g., '01/15/2024', '15 Jan 2024', '2024-01-15'). Do not reformat, normalize, or infer missing dates.
transactions[*].dateISO: The transaction date converted to ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Derive from the printed date field only.
transactions[*].description: The full transaction narrative exactly as printed in the statement's description, memo, or particulars column. This typically includes the payee name, merchant, transaction channel (e.g., 'POS', 'ACH', 'WIRE'), location, or any reference text the bank associates with the transaction. Preserve the original casing and spacing. Do not summarize, truncate, or clean up the value.
transactions[*].referenceNumber: Any unique identifier printed on the statement against this transaction. This includes check numbers, cheque numbers, wire reference codes, ACH trace IDs, authorization codes, transaction IDs, or confirmation numbers. Common labels: 'Ref #', 'Ref No.', 'Chq No.', 'Check No.', 'Trace ID', 'Auth Code', 'TXN ID'. Extract verbatim. Leave null if no reference identifier is present for this row.
transactions[*].type: AI-inferred transaction category. This field is NOT extracted verbatim — classify it by reading the description, the printed transaction code (e.g., 'POS', 'ACH CR', 'ATM WD'), and whether an amount appears in the credit or debit column. Rules: 'Credit' — money arriving in the account (salary, transfers in, interest credited); 'Debit' — card purchases, online payments, POS transactions; 'Transfer' — inter-account or wire movements (both inbound and outbound); 'Deposit' — manual, ATM, or check deposits of funds into the account; 'Direct Deposit' — payroll, government benefits, or tax refunds deposited electronically; 'Withdrawal' — cash taken out at an ATM or bank counter; 'Check' — written check payments cleared against the account; 'Payment' — bill payments, loan repayments, credit card payments; 'Fee' — bank service charges, overdraft fees, account maintenance fees; 'Interest' — interest earned on the account balance or charged on an overdraft; 'Refund' — merchant reversals, returned payments, or disputed transaction credits. Use 'Other' only when none of the above applies and the type genuinely cannot be determined.
